signal.title: Generate Trajectories, Reasoning Traces, and Auto-Labels with NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super
signal.summary: 这项研究围绕视觉—语言—动作模型展开，关注机器人如何把视觉观察和语言指令，持续转换成跨时间的动作，而不是只对当前画面做一次反应。

editorial.intro: 这项研究围绕视觉—语言—动作模型展开，关注机器人如何把视觉观察和语言指令，持续转换成跨时间的动作，而不是只对当前画面做一次反应。
editorial.why_it_matters: VLA 的记忆、推理和实时执行能力，直接决定具身智能能否从演示动作走向长时任务和真实部署。
editorial.watch_next: 继续核对实验是否覆盖真实机器人、长时任务和跨场景泛化。

evidence.title: Generate Trajectories, Reasoning Traces, and Auto-Labels with NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super
evidence.excerpt: Robotics English 中文 Generate Trajectories, Reasoning Traces, and Auto-Labels with NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super Aug 04, 2026 By Boris Ivanovic and Marco Pavone Discuss (0) L T F R E AI-Generated Summary NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super is an open 34-billion-parameter vision-language-action model that combines a 32-billion-parameter Cosmos 3 Super Reasoner with a 2-billion-parameter diffusion-based Action Expert for autonomous vehicle development. The model processes up to seven cameras for 360-degree perception and jointly produces trajectories, Chain-of-Causation reasoning traces, meta-actions, visual question answering with 2D grounding, and structured auto-labels from a single foundation. Open-loop evaluation on 1,434 challenging samples from the Physical AI AV Dataset shows a 6.4-second minADE_6 of 0.911 m, a reasoning score of 0.433 on the Physical AI AV Reasoning Benchmark, and a LingoQA score of 79.2, leading Qwen2.5-VL 72B by 17.0 points. Closed-loop simulation with NVIDIA AlpaSim on 913 reconstructed scenes yields an AlpaSim Score of 1.50 ± 0.13, revealing collisions and close encounters that open-loop metrics miss.
